title: Klahn London Dry Gin
description:
A beautiful handcrafted gin, made and bottled in the Barossa Valley. A contemporary take on a London Dry, distilled with eleven botanicals including juniper, cassia stick and orange peel — warmth, depth and savoury spice.

A classic gin at heart: full-bodied and fresh, with clarity and balance. A rich, clean, juniper-driven spirit.
serve: The G&T benchmark — ice, good tonic, a twist of orange.
